name: Showcase Upgrades
author: JAMM
description: Five idempotent example rod upgrades: Turbo Reel, Deep Diver, Iron Line, Fish Magnet, and Golden Touch.

upgrades.name: Turbo Reel
upgrades.description: Increases reel speed by +2.0 per stack. Stacks up to 3 times.

upgrades.name: Deep Diver
upgrades.description: Increases lure sink speed by +1.5 per stack without slowing your reel. Stacks up to 3 times.

upgrades.name: Iron Line
upgrades.description: Raises maximum line tension (+240 MAX_TENSION per stack). Stacks up to 3 times.

upgrades.name: Fish Magnet
upgrades.description: Increases lure attraction range for all fish (+25% lunge mod and +25 range per stack). Stacks up to 2 times.

upgrades.name: Golden Touch
upgrades.description: Increases caught fish sale value by +25% per stack. Stacks up to 2 times.
